description.value: Sushi Taku is a Japanese restaurant steps from Joyce SkyTrain Station in Vancouver's East Side, offering dine-in and takeout with a menu of maki rolls, nigiri, sashimi, and combo platters. The kitchen also caters group meals and school hot lunches for parties of ten or more. The space is air-conditioned and non-smoking with indoor seating.
